Get a Quote

We build high-performance websites and apps for growth-focused businesses.

Collabrate is a digital agency for businesses that want to grow. We lead design, development, marketing, and AI automation, and deliver the website your customers trust and your team is proud to share, from first brief to launch.

Get a QuoteView Our Work
Our work

Collabrate is a digital development and marketing company founded in 2025, working with businesses across India, Singapore, Malaysia, and the Gulf. We were built on a simple idea: businesses shouldn't have to manage separate vendors for development and marketing. Our team handles both, so what we build is designed to perform, and what we market is backed by something solid.

Pick what you need. We handle the rest.

Whether it's development, marketing, or AI automation, our services are organized around what you're actually trying to achieve.

Get a QuoteAll services

Website Development

We build custom websites designed for speed and conversions, from UI/UX design through development, with performance and search visibility built in from the start, not bolted on later.

Learn more about Website Development

Mobile Application Development

We design and build apps people actually keep using, choosing native or cross-platform based on what the project needs, and carrying it through to App Store and Play Store deployment.

Learn more about Mobile Application Development

SEO

We handle SEO end to end: fixing the technical foundation, writing optimized content, and targeting the keywords your customers actually search, so rankings turn into real traffic.

Learn more about SEO

Performance Marketing

We plan, create, and run paid campaigns across Google, Meta, and LinkedIn, building the creatives as well as the targeting, and adjusting budgets based on what's actually converting.

Learn more about Performance Marketing

AI Chatbots

We build hybrid chatbots, combining structured flows with AI, trained on your actual business data, not generic scripts, and deployed across your website, WhatsApp, Instagram, or wherever your customers already are.

Learn more about AI Chatbots

Workflow Automation

We automate repetitive tasks across the tools you already use, connecting them with Zapier, Make, or custom scripts, so work moves between systems automatically instead of relying on manual handoffs.

Learn more about Workflow Automation

AI Voice Assistants

We build voice systems that handle calls without a person on the line, covering appointment booking and common questions, with every call transcribed and summarized so nothing gets lost.

Learn more about AI Voice Assistants

Our Work

A look at the platforms and applications we've built across different industries.

Sports & Recreation

Turf Booking Platform

Customers can now book and manage turf sessions entirely online, with a streamlined experience across booking, tickets, and food ordering.

View project
HR & Recruitment

HR & Recruitment Dashboard

A faster, more organized recruitment process with less manual coordination.

View project
Enterprise Software / B2B

Enterprise Software Business Website

A polished digital presence that supports credibility in enterprise sales conversations.

View project
Fitness & Wellness

Gym Trainer App

A more organized way for trainers to manage client relationships digitally.

View project
Food & Dairy

Dairy Vendor Management App

Smoother day-to-day operations for dairy distribution.

View project
Food & Dairy

Dairy Vendor Management App (2)

Improved coordination and reduced manual tracking for vendor operations.

View project

Project-based or ongoing engagements
What we build is backed by the marketing that follows

Industries We Work With

From early-stage startups to large-scale enterprises, we build and manage digital infrastructure suited to the scale, complexity, and goals of every business we work with.

Get a QuoteView Our Work
01

Booking & Scheduling Platforms

For sports facilities, fitness studios, and service-based businesses managing appointments and availability.

02

Vendor & Distribution Management

For dairy, FMCG, and supply-chain businesses coordinating vendors, inventory, and delivery.

03

Workforce & Recruitment Systems

For HR teams and agencies managing job postings, applicants, and hiring pipelines.

04

Business & Corporate Websites

For professional services and B2B companies building credibility and generating inquiries.

05

E-commerce Websites and Online Stores

For businesses selling products online, built for browsing, trust, and checkout conversion.

Frequently asked questions

Can't find what you're looking for? Tell us what you're trying to achieve and we'll point you in the right direction.

Get a Quote

Yes. Most projects mix development, marketing, and AI, for example a new website with SEO and a chatbot from day one. We scope combined engagements as one project, not separate contracts.

Ready to build something that works?

Tell us what you're trying to achieve, and we'll come back with a clear plan and a quote.

Build, market, and grow with one accountable team.
